description: This file defines classes and methods related to the Voyage embedding service, including error handling, configuration, URL management, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing for the Voyage AI embeddings API.

classes.name: VoyageError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Voyage API errors, capturing status code, message, request, and response details.

classes.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Voyage embedding API, providing URL, parameter mapping, validation, request/response transformation.

methods.name: VoyageError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes VoyageError with status code, message, request, and response information.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL based on base URL and model.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by Voyage API.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI style parameters to Voyage API parameters.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and retrieves API key, returning authorization headers.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format required for the Voyage embedding request.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Parses and maps the raw response from Voyage API into the EmbeddingResponse object, handling errors.

methods.name: VoyageEmbeddingConfig.get_error_class
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of VoyageError.
